card.name: Linking words before risk-factor or pH terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas just before a lab or physiology term, such as pH, serum, platelet counts or smoking. Seen in clotting-risk lists and in rise/increase-in-pH wording.

modes.label: Commas in risk-factor lists
modes.description: Comma or 'and' inside a list of modifiable clotting risk factors.

modes.label: Increase in a measure
modes.description: 'in', 'as' or 'serum' right after rise/increase, before pH, counts or viscosity.
modes.example: Thrombotic/thromboembolic complications may result from increases<< in>> platelet counts with ALVAIZ.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in lists of clot risk factors and in phrases about a rising pH or lab value.
